tools.name: get_session_state
tools.description:
Get the current session state stored in a session dataset.
Each session has at most one state record per dataset. Call this at the beginning of every turn to restore session context. Pass fields to retrieve only the listed top-level fields (comma-separated) and avoid loading large state.

tools.name: set_session_state
tools.description:
Store the session state of a session dataset, replacing whatever was stored before.
Each session has at most one state record per dataset. Pass the complete state: use update_session_state to merge fields instead.

tools.name: update_session_state
tools.description:
Merge fields into the session state of a session dataset.
Only the passed top-level fields are written; the rest of the stored state is kept. Use it for incremental progress instead of rewriting the whole state.

tools.name: query_dataset_records
tools.description:
Query records stored in a dataset, newest first.
Records are returned with their metadata (id, run_id, agent_id, run_started_at) and the data itself. A filter is ANDed exact matches over schema fields and only scans the most recent records, so bound it with from/to for a long history.

tools.name: insert_dataset_record
tools.description:
Insert one record into a dataset.
The record is stamped with the current run and session, so a record always says which run produced it. Fields not in the dataset schema are dropped.

tools.name: update_dataset_record
tools.description:
Update one record of a dataset by id.
Only the passed fields are merged into the stored record, so pass every field you mean to keep changed and leave the rest out.

tools.name: delete_dataset_record
tools.description:
Delete one record of a dataset by id.
Deleting needs full permission on the dataset; a write-only binding cannot delete.
